summary: Kingdom Gates & Automation are ordering a Roger swing gate kit, accessories and outdoor CAT6 cable for their Kenmare job, for delivery to their Tralee yard by 19 November.

fulfilment.instructions: Deliver to the Tralee yard, not the Kenmare job; if arriving after 16:00, call Mike on 087 555 0164 as the gate will be locked.

lines.description: Roger brushless swing kit (2 leaves, about 2.5m each)
lines.match_note: Roger brushless swing kit supports 2 leaves up to 3m each.
Assumed Roger F4ES surface-mount photocells to accompany the Roger kit; quantity is pairs.
Roger 2-channel remote matches the 2-button remotes requested for the kit.
Assumed Roger R92/LED flashing beacon to accompany the Roger kit.
Assumed Roger H85/TDS surface key selector switch for the gate kit.
Matched standard external CAT6 cable box; assumed catalogue 305m black PE specification.

flags.message: Prices are missing for all 6 order lines; confirm account pricing before booking.
For delivery after 16:00, the driver must call Mike on 087 555 0164 because the yard gate will be locked.
Quote separately for 2 x 12V 7Ah batteries (FT-BAT-12V7); these are explicitly not ordered.
Thursday resolves to 19 November 2026 from the email dated 16 November 2026.
